visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit at a round wooden table in a brightly lit pink-toned studio. The woman on the left wears a white camisole and pink patterned shorts, using a silver laptop. The woman on the right wears a pink top and white skirt, flipping through a notebook. The background features white curved alcoves holding decorative vases and warm backlighting. Large pink text 'Get Ready' and then 'Get Ready with Us' appears centered. (2) A medium shot shows the woman in white stretching her arms forward. A digital notification overlay pops up mentioning a gathering at 12:00. She checks her red smartphone with a shocked expression, mouth open. (3) She hurriedly jumps onto a beige couch, grabbing a white pillow or clothing item. The camera follows her quick movement as she moves from the table to the lounge area. (4) The scene transitions to a close-up of a pink square-shaped makeup compact labeled 'Glad2Glow'. Hands open the compact to reveal a cushion and a mirror. Text highlights product features in Chinese. A woman in a pink top applies the cushion to her face with a puff, smiling at the camera. Close-up shots emphasize smooth skin texture. (5) A multi-frame sequence shows both women in formal dresses (white and pink) posing and applying makeup. A camera interface overlay appears, simulating a smartphone photo mode. (6) The two women are now at an indoor cafe or restaurant, dressed in white and pink dresses, carrying shell-shaped purses. They are seen laughing and eating desserts like cake and fruit with colorful drinks on the table. (7) In an evening setting with warm artificial light, the woman in white checks her reflection in a mirror, touching her cheek. They pose together in a modern hallway, leaning against each other and smiling brightly. (8) Back in the studio, one woman holds the pink compact in front of her face. Then both women hold up their respective compacts, posing towards the camera. Text overlays provide purchasing information for POYA and Shopee. (9) A final close-up shows hands closing a white shell-shaped purse with a pearl strap. The Glad2Glow logo appears over a blurred studio background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic pop music begins immediately. A youthful female voice speaks clearly in Mandarin, 'Get Ready with Us,' with a friendly and energetic tone. A distinct high-pitched 'ding' notification sound occurs at the 2-second mark. (2) The BGM continues with a steady 124 BPM rhythm featuring synthesized bass and bright percussive hits. As the woman on screen moves quickly, a soft fabric rustling sound with low spectral bandwidth is heard. (3) The female narrator's voice returns, describing the 'Glad2Glow' product with professional clarity and moderate arousal. A sharp 'click' sound accompanies the visual of the makeup compact being opened. (4) The BGM maintains its energy. Three quick camera shutter 'click-click-click' sounds are heard as the visuals show a photo-taking montage. The narrator emphasizes the product benefits with a rising intonation on key adjectives. (5) The BGM swells slightly in the mix as the scene shifts to the cafe. Muted ambient room tone is present beneath the music. The narrator continues speaking until the end, maintaining a cheerful and persuasive tone. (6) A final metallic 'click' or latch sound is heard as the purse closes. The music fades out quickly over the last two seconds, ending on a clean harmonic resolution.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Social Evidence -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for Glad2Glow cushion foundation. It utilizes a 'Get Ready With Us' (GRWM) vlog style to create a relatable scenario where the creators are in a hurry. It highlights the product's speed of application, high coverage, and long-lasting nature through a day-to-night progression, ultimately encouraging viewers to purchase it at specific retailers like POYA and Shopee.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation in voiceover, brand logo overlays, and purchase call-to-action text.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high production values and popular influencers to appeal to a young, beauty-focused audience through social-native editing.
